instructions: Which capability should handle the user's request?

reject.label: REJECT
reject.card:
### REJECT
tool: none
does: No listed capability correctly handles the user's request. Choose this option only when none of the other options is the right capability.

中文：以上列出的能力都不适用于该请求。只有当其它选项都不是正确的能力时才选它。
reject.meaning: no listed capability correctly handles the request; present on every row as exactly one option

option_order_rule: per-row deterministic shuffle; seed prefix reject-shuffle-v1 over the row id; in-place K=0->K=1 repaired rows use seed prefix k0-to-k1-inplace-v1:<threshold>:<split> over the row id; option count = capability candidates + 1

calibration.rule: min(400, n_train // 10) over the FINAL (post-shuffle) train order

row_order.note: output slot p holds the pre-shuffle row permutation[p]

repair.rule: K=0, is_action=true, candidate_count=0, and source_gold_capability_id is a valid capability
repair.action: inject the source gold as the only capability candidate; keep REJECT; K=1; options=2
repair.construction_audit_note: construction_audit.jsonl preserves the pre-repair retrieval evidence and is intentionally not rewritten; row-level repaired state is recorded in the in-place repair audit detail.
